name: vanta-studio-site
description: Vanta Studio marketing site. Static / no build step (see CLAUDE.md §2). This manifest exists only to declare the @vercel/functions dependency used by middleware.mjs — there is no front-end bundling. Do NOT add a "type":"module" field: it would switch the CommonJS serverless functions in api/ to ESM and break them (the middleware uses a .mjs extension precisely to stay ESM without that flag).
